title: Four Knights Game: Spanish Variation
line: The bishop pins the knight as in the Ruy Lopez, and Black answers by jumping into the center.

steps.text: The Four Knights Game: all four knights are out.
Bring the bishop out to attack the knight that guards the pawn on e5, as in the Ruy Lopez.
steps.after: Black does not guard the pawn. Its knight jumps forward and attacks your knight.

steps.text: The pawn on e5 is offered. Taking it with the knight lets Black chase it with the queen and grab your pawn on e4 later.
Trade the knight on d4 instead. It was your knight's attacker.

also.b5c4: That is also played. This lesson trades the knight.
also.e1g1: Castling is also played. This lesson trades the knight.

steps.after: The pawn that took back attacks your other knight.

steps.text: Do not move the knight. Push the pawn on e4 one square and attack the knight on f6 in return.
Take Black's knight. You are even again.
Take back the pawn on c3 with a pawn. Material is even again.
steps.after: Taking with this pawn opens a line for your bishop on c1.

steps.text: Castle. Your king is safe, and the rook can come to the open center files.

also.d1e2: The queen check is also played. This lesson castles.

steps.after: Many pieces are gone and the game is level. Black has met the pin with play of its own.

summary: The bishop pins as in the Ruy Lopez. Black jumps a knight to the center, and trades lead to a level game.
